notes: Supplied *into* before the bare directional accusative בֵּית יְהוָה belongs to the noun under rule 33, not to the verb under rule 44: בּוֹא is intransitive and the place noun is an accusative of direction, exactly rule 33's *to your mountain*. Corpus precedent puts the word on בַּיִת in 50 units (rule 33) against 10 on the verb.
